name: Becca Willow Moss
bio: Becca Willow Moss is an advocate for using artistic outlets to express the emotional landscape of the body. As an actor, singer, director, writer, and multi-media artist, she employs all art forms to communicate with others. She is a classically trained soprano, having performed across North America, Europe and Israel. Her recent films have brought her to festivals, such as TIFF, VIFF and Montreal Festival du Nouveau Cinema. Becca Willow has extensive experience with artistic output, outreach, hyperstylized aesthetics and creating community-based films.

credits.title: Investigations of a Breakup
credits.overview: Sophia struggles with overthinking her life as a poor, nihilistic drifter. Exiled to a life of solitude, she has the chance to change it all upon meeting Liza one night...  Did she let her in or was she destined to burn it all? The aftermath of their breakup is explored through three different angles.

credits.title: The Sphinx
credits.overview: At an open mic night, a young comedian tries out new material when her estranged father shows up, seizing the stage to reveal a buried past and connect with the daughter he barely knows.

credits.title: Her Last Supper
credits.overview: Debut feature directed by Becca-Willow Moss.

credits.title: Paying for It
credits.overview: In the late 1990s, when Sonny seeks to redefine his long-term relationship with Chester, the painfully introverted cartoonist begins sleeping with sex workers and discovers an unexpected new form of intimacy.

credits.title: The Jokes
credits.overview: After accidentally burning his breakfast, a man goes to a nearby cafe and struggles to read a graphic novel.

credits.title: A Part of Me
credits.overview: Young lovers, Anthony and Caroline, realize they're both harbouring a dark secret that brings them closer together. Much closer.

credits.title: A Sad, Sad Ghost Picking at the Hairs of Their Knuckles

credits.title: This Place
credits.overview: Living in the liminal space between worlds, two young women find themselves falling in love for the first time, while also being forced to unexpectedly confront their families, each complicated by legacies of love and loss.
